This impressive performance marked him as the first Australian player to secure multiple centuries across all formats. Alongside Inglis, Alex Carey shone brightly with an important contribution of 80 runs, leading Australia to a 100-run advantage after dismissing South Africa for 329.

Despite facing substantial challenges, with a net loss of Rs 1,879.1 crore for the September quarter, Walsh emphasizes the importance of cutting expenses and maintaining operational efficiency to manage these rising costs successfully.

The men say they were testing the state's election rules and did not cast any ballots. Prosecutors argue that using someone else's identity while seeking a ballot is illegal.

Her grandson reported finding $16,000, while another family member claimed it contained $400,000, an eight-carat diamond ring and gold coins. The grandmother's niece later won nearly $797,000 in damages, but an appeals court overturned the award on Tuesday, citing her failure to follow the required legal process.

This adjustment will grant farmers an additional Rs 7 per litre, while cooperatives will benefit from Re 1. Farmers, who currently earn Rs 35 per litre, will see their income boosted to Rs 42.

description: Elon Musk has expressed his belief that artificial intelligence will create a future of abundance and wealth equality. He suggests that traditional currency will decline in relevance as production costs diminish due to robotics. Musk envisions a scenario where universal high income might mitigate unemployment caused by automation. His views indicate a significant shift in economic paradigms influenced by advancements in technology.

title: Shedeur Sanders’ rare update comes amid Browns trade speculation
description: Shedeur Sanders made a rare Instagram post as the NFL trade deadline approaches, causing speculation about his future. Despite trade rumors, the Cleveland Browns reportedly are not looking to trade Sanders or Gabriel. With Deshaun Watson performing well and Gabriel returning, the quarterback situation in Cleveland is increasingly complex. Sanders has only played minimally this season, with Watson solidifying his role.

title: Hyderabad developer relocates 800 mango trees for road instead of cutting them
description: Faced with the challenge of relocating 800 mango trees for a new road project in Hyderabad, Ashwin Rao opted for preservation instead of removal. With the Vata Foundation's expertise in translocating trees, including banyans, Rao meticulously planned the move to ensure the mango trees thrive in their new home. The foundation has successfully relocated more than 17,500 trees, showcasing their commitment to environmental conservation.

title: China deploys over 50 vessels in western Pacific, raising alarm in Taiwan, Japan
description: In a significant military maneuver, China has stationed over 50 naval vessels, including 34 warships and the aircraft carrier Liaoning, in key zones of the western Pacific. This show of force has raised alarms within Taiwan's National Security Council, which identifies a dual threat to Taiwan, Japan, and the Philippines.

title: It only takes one rumour: How a small trigger can lead to a deadly stampede
description: On October 17, a tragic stampede in Kolkata claimed 19 lives during the Durga Puja celebrations. The incident was caused by overcrowding, panic, and a misleading announcement about structural failure. Experts emphasize the importance of effective crowd management to prevent similar tragedies in the future. Investigators are examining various factors contributing to the disaster, including narrow exits and inadequate safety measures.

title: 2,000-year-old Vesuvius bread still shows 8 segments and baker's stamp
description: A loaf of bread left inside an oven in Herculaneum during the AD 79 eruption of Mount Vesuvius was discovered carbonised during excavations in 1930. The nearly 2,000-year-old find offers a glimpse into ancient Roman food habits. The British Museum later recreated the bread, while other preserved loaves reveal how Romans divided bread into portions and used stamps to identify it.

title: Nobody should attend funerals of farmers who take their own lives: MLA Sanjay Gaikwad
description: MLA Sanjay Gaikwad said that if ‘nobody attended a farmer’s funeral and animals fed on the body, it might make others contemplating suicide realise the consequences and deter them from taking their own lives’

title: China may deploy orbital lasers to blind US satellites by late 2020s: Report
description: China's advancements in space-based directed-energy weapons are raising alarms, with operational capabilities potentially emerging by the late 2020s. These weapons threaten the integrity of enemy satellites, essential for contemporary military strategies. The US Defense Intelligence Agency has indicated that these developments expose significant vulnerabilities in US military satellite operations, jeopardizing crucial communication, navigation, intelligence, and missile warning systems, which are key to effective military engagement.

title: Elena Rybakina clinches year-end world No. 1 ranking for first time ahead of WTA Finals
description: Elena Rybakina has officially clinched the coveted year-end world No. 1 ranking after triumphing over Yulia Putintseva in Tokyo. This victory marks a significant milestone, solidifying her position at the top of women's tennis for the very first time. Rybakina's remarkable 2026 season featured Grand Slam victories at both the Australian Open and US Open, elevating her tally to three. In addition, she celebrated wins in Stuttgart and Ningbo.

title: Odisha homemaker farms 25-30 tonnes of fish yearly, earns Rs 7-10 lakh
description: After observing the vast potential at Hirakud Reservoir, Sujata Bhuyan from Odisha transformed her life through fish farming. Engaging with the Fisheries Department for training, she turned her vision into reality, producing about 25 to 30 metric tonnes of fish annually. Her remarkable achievements caught the attention of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who shared her inspiring story in Mann Ki Baat, showcasing the significance of support in nurturing rural businesses.

title: Ex-Bangladesh air force officer linked to Hasina's fleeing clip found dead in Dhaka
24 wins, 7 titles, 1 heartbreaking defeat: Wrestler Kalkal's winning streak ends
description: Sujeet Kalkal’s wait for a World Championships medal continued as the Indian wrestler suffered a heartbreaking defeat in the men’s 65kg quarterfinals on Thursday. Sujeet lost 3-3 on criteria to Tajikistan’s Abdulmazhid Kudiev, bringing his 24-match winning streak to an end.

title: WhatsApp co-founder Jan Koum's $36m gift helps open new LA school campus
description: WhatsApp co-founder Jan Koum's $36 million donation has helped Milken Community School open a new campus in Bel Air, Los Angeles, for students in grades 9 to 12. Inaugurated on Sunday, the campus has expanded the school's total footprint to 28 acres across three locations. The opening comes as the school reports a 40% rise in applications.

title: 'Hit phone on wall': SC wonders what's 'wrong' with victims of digital arrest
Richard Simmons' Hollywood Hills home sells for $3.8m after $6.99m listing
description: After a price cut from $6.99 million, Richard Simmons' Sunset Strip estate has sold for $3.827 million. Initially listed in June 2025, the Colonial-style house piqued interest but failed to secure deals until now. The new buyer aims to preserve the home’s historical charm and scenic vistas while contemplating redevelopment in this sought-after area.

title: Insurance firm denied Rs 5 lakh to sister after brother's death, Allahabad HC overrules
description: The Allahabad high court has made a significant decision by siding with an unmarried sister in an insurance claim case, ordering Oriental Insurance Company to pay her Rs 5 lakh after her brother's death. Initially denied coverage due to her not being designated as a family member, the court made it clear that beneficiaries with documentation are entitled to benefits no matter the familial definitions.

title: Russia drone hits 2 trains at busy Ukraine station, 13 killed
Bihar woman loses son to electric shock, starts solar irrigation for 38 farmers
description: Ladli Khatoon from Bahwanpur, Bihar, has transformed her family's tragedy into a solar irrigation venture. After losing her son, she discovered the risks of conventional irrigation methods and sought alternatives. Through support from JEEViKA and local organizations, she established a solar irrigation business, benefiting many farmers. This initiative has enabled several women to earn incomes and gain respect in their communities.

title: From Hitler to India’s farmers: How Great Depression changed lives beyond US
description: The October 1929 stock market crash in the United States ignited a global economic disaster that resulted in widespread unemployment and business closures. In Germany and India, the crisis led to heightened political unrest and movements for independence. Falling agricultural prices devastated Indian farmers, pushing them closer to revolution against British oppression. Meanwhile, Britain faced significant industrial downturns and job losses, highlighting the urgent need for international economic collaboration.

title: Big shake-up! MI confirm exits of three coaches, including Malinga
description: Mumbai Indians have parted ways with coaches Lasith Malinga, Paras Mhambrey and Carl Hopkinson ahead of IPL 2027. Malinga contributed to four IPL titles, while Mhambrey helped develop the team’s bowling talent and Hopkinson worked on fielding standards. The exits follow Mahela Jayawardene’s departure after mixed results in his second stint as head coach.

title: Spain train crash: Audio reveals chilling exchange before deadly collision
description: According to the recordings published by Spanish outlets including El País and RTVE, a technical problem had disrupted the automatic signalling system, forcing trains on the affected stretch to stop. The system helps control train movements and prevents trains from entering sections of track when it may be unsafe to do so.

title: Israel polls: Netanyahu cries foul; poll chief orders probe into 'foreign hand'
MLC polls: BJP wins big, but Congress & SP send a message from Nagpur, Varanasi
description: While the BJP-led NDA won big in the MLC elections across four states, it suffered setbacks in two politically significant constituencies: Nagpur and Varanasi where the Congress and SP held their ground.

title: Tea shop worker turned lawyer helps 30 tribal families, one lands govt job
description: Advocate V Akathiyan made a significant visit to Vayaloor village to aid 30 tribal families in acquiring overdue caste certificates, essential for expanding educational and job prospects. One of the beneficiaries, M Manikandan, secured a government clerk role thanks to the certificate. Akathiyan’s dedication also encompasses more tribal regions, addressing legal issues and fundamental necessities, showcasing how essential documentation can drive social equity.

title: UFC commits $1 million to brain health research with WWE and boxing athletes
description: UFC has renewed its partnership with Cleveland Clinic, pledging to explore the impact of head injuries until 2030. With WWE and Zuffa Boxing athletes joining the research, the initiative will broaden its reach. The focus lies on understanding the lasting effects of head trauma on athlete health. Over 900 volunteers have signed up, enabling continuous research to improve safety measures and protection in sports.

title: Bangladesh: Hindu salon owner stabbed to death over unpaid haircut bills; 1 held
Wife leaves at 5.17am, lover enters 3mins later: CCTV captures plot to kill husband
description: On October 26, a woman named Priya allegedly conspired with her gym trainer lover to stab her husband. CCTVs captured Priya leaving their home in Ghaziabad shortly before the attack occurred. The attack was brutal, happening while Shashank was asleep next to their young daughter. Shashank was immediately rushed to the intensive care unit after suffering severe injuries. Both Priya and her accomplice have been arrested and face multiple charges.

title: XUV700 booked in 2022, never delivered: Mahindra ordered to refund and pay Rs 62k
description: A consumer in Haryana sought redress after Mahindra & Mahindra failed to deliver a booked SUV. The booking was made in February 2022, but the vehicle was never delivered to the customer. The manufacturer and dealer provided contradictory claims regarding the situation surrounding the delayed delivery. Consequently, the consumer commission found both parties guilty of unfair trade practices and ordered compensation.

title: Decoys, secret jet and Trump's help: How Bolsonaro pulled off his escape to US
‘He still has a lot to prove’: Waqar makes bold claim on Jasprit Bumrah
description: Waqar Younis praised Jasprit Bumrah’s remarkable skills in white-ball formats but raised questions about his Test career achievements. Although Bumrah maintains a solid Test record, concerns linger due to his limited appearances caused by injuries. Younis emphasized Bumrah’s pivotal moments, especially during the T20 World Cup against Pakistan, while anticipating his return for the upcoming Test series against New Zealand next month.

title: Appeals court backs Prairie Lake access, overturns $148K trespass award
description: A nine-year property dispute over access to Minnesota's Prairie Lake has taken another turn after an appeals court upheld a ruling in favour of the Blackwood Trust. The Monday decision confirms the trust's direct access to the lake and leaves an earlier $148,500 trespass award to neighbouring property owners cancelled. The dispute centred on conflicting land surveys dating back to 1997.

title: Cong calls Rahul's 'Sitarama' misspelling in Tata post 'typo marketing', mocks BJP
California couple wins garden rights after neighbour’s 1955 deal for $250
description: A California couple who bought a home in 2019 found themselves in a legal battle after their neighbour claimed ownership of a 20-by-20-foot garden they believed was theirs. The dispute centred on a 1955 agreement involving $250, babysitting services and land access rights. On Monday, a California appeals court upheld the couple's exclusive right to use the garden.

title: Brahmaputra-Kaveri link: India’s river-interlinking dream explained and the roadblocks ahead
description: India is working on an initiative to interlink rivers, particularly focusing on the connection between Brahmaputra and Kaveri. This proposal aims to address water scarcity in southern states, which often experience erratic rainfall. Several challenges exist, including interstate disputes, environmental concerns, and the need for technical feasibility. The Godavari-Kaveri link is critical in this proposal, but agreement among states remains complex.

title: Zuckerberg & wife give California $50 mn weeks after donation shift announcement
description: In a significant move, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan announced a generous $50 million contribution to Sacramento State University’s redevelopment. The funds will be directed towards building a new downtown campus with essential student housing and cutting-edge STEM resources. California Governor Gavin Newsom praised this gift's role in training future technology leaders and meeting housing demands.

title: TOI Opinion: Rotinomics - The Tyranny of the Phulka
